_how_to_use: Copy this file, rename it (e.g. test_case_2.json, the name must NOT start with _), fill it in. Files starting with _ are ignored. Every .json file in this folder is a test case the bot can pick. Optional: add "start_url": "https://..." to start this case on a different page than bot_settings.json's start_url. auto_answer_buttons: buttons the bot clicks if the site asks a yes/no question (e.g. 'do you need help with anything else?'); default ["No"]; [] turns it off.
name: Short name shown in the report, e.g. Wireless - Shopping - iPhone quote
scripted_messages: First message (sent after the agent's greeting + reply_delay_seconds)
Second message (sent after the agent's next reply + reply_delay_seconds)
Last message, e.g. thank you for your time, bye

survey.comment: Good Service, thanks or a human
